notes: Done checks met: criterion 1 (six decider processes released at one barrier all start and exit 0, the history holds exactly six terminated lines, one per context, and no process says 'not append-only'; the in-process interleaving, the overlap and the non-git fallback tests pass); criterion 2 (a seen line removed, changed, reordered or the file emptied is still refused at the start check and at the end check, while another run's appended line is accepted; a live lock held past the wait refuses with a named error and a dead holder's lock is swept); criterion 3 (each run's line_index is the verified position of its own line and the Claude rotation reason equals the rotation recomputed from the committed file). The red tests failed by assertion on the pre-change tree (12 failures for 11 ids, 0 errors) and pass after the green, which removed the expectedFailure marks and changed no test logic. Known limits stated in the reviews: residual lock races named in bug 405 (a live lock swept by age, a create-then-write gap on Linux, a Windows delete-pending name); an unlocked writer can still append a line (outside tamper evidence for a prefix); the card-mode branch of gate_seat has no test of its own. Bug 374 (prompt files in the repository root) is the card right after; the removal of the one-seat-at-a-time line from the D228 preflight is a later Decider after both cards ship. Five older mob-defaults tests fail on the base and after (bug 406).
